shared_elements: carved motifs on tan/weathered stone surface
curvilinear incised outlines suggestive of animal or bird forms
photographic scale bar placed against the carved surface
sunlit outdoor rock with sky/background visible
justification: Both show sunlit tan stone bearing carved curvilinear, possibly zoomorphic outlines recorded with a scale bar, which is about the extent of the correspondence. A is a natural boulder with shallow, weathered, scattered incisions of ambiguous subject, whereas B is a dressed rectangular pillar carrying crisp raised relief organised into stacked registers of clearly readable animals, so composition and technique differ fundamentally.
